content: Yerɑ Elifɑsi, Temɑɡii u Yoobu wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: tɔnu u ko n ɑrufɑɑni mɔ Gusunɔn mi?
Aɑwo! Tɔnu ù n sɑ̃ɑ dee dee, win tiin ɑrufɑɑniwɑ.
A tɑmɑɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡemɡii,
Gusunɔ u yen ɑre wɑɑmɔ?
À n sĩimɔ dee dee ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ u wɑɑmɔ.
A tɑmɑɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ nùn mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ,
yen sɔ̃nɑ u nun sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ?
A tɑmɑɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ nùn nɑsie,
yen sɔ̃nɑ u nun sirimɔ?
Aɑwo. Wunɛn torɑ dɑbinun sɔ̃nɑ u nun sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ.
Wunɛn kɔ̃sɑ yɑ mɑɑ kpɑ̃.
Domi ɑ wunɛn berusebun yɑ̃nu tɔrubɑ mwɑ,
mɑ ɑ bu deri tereru.
A ǹ wi nim nɔru ɡɑ mɔ̀ nim kɑ̃ u nɔ.
Mɛyɑ ɑ ǹ mɑɑ wi ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ mɔ̀ dĩɑnu kɑ̃ u di.
A rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ dɑmɡii kɑ bɛɛrɛɡii,
mɑ ɑ tem mɛ kpuro mɔ.
A ɡɔminibu ɡirɑwɑ bɑ doonɑ nɔm dirɑ, ɑ ǹ bu somi.
Mɑ ɑ ɡobekubɑn dɑm buɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ yɛ̃ri nun wɑ̃ɑsi beri berikɑ,
mɑ bɛrum nun mwɑ subɑru sɔɔ.
Mɑ yɑm wɔ̃kurɑ nun wukiri nɡe nim bwee bɑkɑru,
ɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɑm wɑɑmɔ.
Sɑ yɛ̃ mɑ Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ.
A mɛɛrio ɑ wɑ sere mi kperi wɑ̃ɑ.
Kɑ mɛ, ɑ ɡerumɔ ɑ mɔ̀, mbɑ Gusunɔ u yɛ̃.
U ǹ kpɛ̃ u tɔnu siri ɡuru wiru sɔɔ.
Guru wiru tɑ sinum mɔ,
u ǹ kpɛ̃ u ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑ min di.
U sirenɛwɑ wɔllu mi tɔnɑ.
Yoobu, ɑ yɔ̃rɑriwɑ ɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowobun yirɑ ye swĩi?
A ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ bɑ bu ɡo ben ɡɔɔn sɑɑ yu sere turi?
Bɑ doonɑ nɡe ɡɑnɑ ye yɑ nim diirɑ.
Tɔn ben bweseru bɑ rɑ rɑɑ Gusunɔ sɔ̃wɑ bu nɛɛ,
u bu derio sɛ̃ɛ.
Mbɑ wi Dɑm kpuroɡii u koo kpĩ u bu kuɑ.
N deemɑ Gusunɔ wiyɑ u rɑɑ ben yɛnun dukiɑ kuurɑsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ nùn sɑɑwɑrɑ kue,
ye bɑ ben himbɑ yiimɔ.
Be bɑ ɡem swĩi bɑ koo yɛ̃ɛri,
bɑ̀ n tɔn kɔ̃so wɑ u kɑm kuɑ.
Be bɑ ǹ tɑɑrɛ mɔ, bɑ koo yɛ̃ɛwɑ bu nɛɛ,
wee, bɛsɛn yibɛrɛ u kɑm kuɑ,
win dukiɑ ye u mɔ kpuro, yɑ dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ.
Yoobu, ɑ kɑ Gusunɔ doro, kpɑ ye kpuro yu nun sɑnɔ kuɑ.
À n kuɑ mɛ, wunɛn nuku dobu koo wurɑmɑ.
A win sɔ̃ɔsiru swɑɑ dɑkio kpɑ ɑ tu nɛnɛ ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
À n kɑ kɔ̃sɑ tondɑ mɑ ɑ wurɑmɑ,
Dɑm kpuroɡii koo nun wunɛn yellun wɑ̃ɑru wesiɑ.
A wunɛn wurɑ ye ɑ mɔ kɔ̃ɔwɔ temɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ wunɛn kpee ɡobiɡiru deri dɑɑrun torɑɔ,
kpɑ Dɑm kpuroɡii u ko wunɛn wurɑ kɑ wunɛn sii ɡeesu.
Sɑɑ yerɑ kɑɑ n nuku dobu mɔ Gusunɔ Dɑm kpuroɡiin mi.
Kpɑ ɑ nùn nɑɑnɛ ko, ɑ nùn wunɛn wuswɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsi.
À n nùn kɑnɑ u koo nun wisi,
kpɑ ɑ wunɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛnu yibiɑ.
Ye ɑ niɑ kuɑ kpuro, yɑ koo koorɑwɑ.
Wunɛn swɛɛ yi ɑ swĩi kpuro, yi ko n dɛɛrewɑ.
À n wɑ̃ɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ,
kɑɑ tii kɑwɑ ɑ nɛɛ, tii suɑbɑ bu nun tu kpɛ̃ɛ.
Kpɑ Gusunɔ u nun wɔlle suɑ.
U koo mɑm tɑɑrɛɡii yɑrɑ kɔ̃sɑn di,
wunɛn dɛɛrɑrun sɔ̃.

content: Yoobu u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ kun kĩ u kɑ nùn ɡɑri ko
